name: Bosley's Good-Luck Charm
description: A tarnished amulet worn smooth by anxious fingers. Against all odds, it works.

effects.name: Bet You Can't Do That Again
effects.description: When you take a hit that deals 25% or more of your Max HP in damage, gain +8 DR against the next incoming attack.

effects.name: Bosley's Fortune
effects.description: When both Bosley's set pieces are equipped, the DR bonus from Bet You Can't Do That Again is doubled to +16.

name: Bosley's Lucky Ring
description: A cheap copper ring with a bent band. You can't explain why you keep it, but you can't bring yourself to throw it away.

effects.name: Not Today
effects.description: When you roll a 2 or 3 on a 2d10 Defense check, reduce the damage you take by half instead of taking the full amount.

effects.name: Bosley's Fortune
effects.description: When both Bosley's set pieces are equipped, Not Today negates all damage instead of halving it.

name: Coin of the Nivh'dhre
description: A coin from a civilization that shouldn't exist. It clings to your hand like it was made for it.

effects.name: Embrace Power
effects.description: Choose one power you own. That power always Benefits. You cannot voluntarily drop the Coin.

effects.name: Darkness
effects.description: You gain an extra 1d4 Ruin per session. The GM may call for Dark Tutelage rolls (2d10+MIND vs TN 15) when the coin's influence becomes relevant.

name: Last Tear of the Ivory Queen
description: A crystalline gem that weeps light. It is said to be the final tear shed by a queen who gave everything for her people.

effects.name: Mercy of the Ivory Queen
effects.description: Once per Full Rest, protect an adjacent Ally from a fatal blow. If the incoming damage exceeds half the target's Max HP, this effect fails.

effects.name: A Mother's Sacrifice
effects.description: Once per campaign, remove the gem and touch a fallen ally who died within the last 24 hours to revive them. This destroys the artifact permanently.

name: Ocrun's Might
description: A massive iron maul that smells faintly of scorched earth. The flames come when it counts.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Ocrun's Raging Fire
effects.description: On an attack roll of 18–20, deal additional Fire damage equal to your MIGHT.

upgrades.name: Ocrun's Undying Strength
upgrades.description: Ocrun's Raging Fire also forces a MIGHT vs MIGHT contest. If you win, the target gains Hindrance for 1 round. If you lose, you are Staggered for 1 round.

name: Courier, Chord of the Stars
description: A bow carved from wood that no longer exists. Each arrow loosed hums like a plucked string.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Starfire Arrow
effects.description: Expend 1 Class Resource. Make a Basic Ranged attack at Very Far range that deals Fire damage instead of Physical.

upgrades.name: Volley
upgrades.description: Passive. On an attack roll of 16–20, make a second Basic Ranged attack against the same target for free.

name: Stormbringer, Gavel of the Faithful
description: A divine warhammer that crackles with restrained lightning. Its judgment falls once, but falls completely.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Judgment
effects.description: Once per Full Rest, make a Basic Melee attack against an adjacent target. On a hit, deal Electric damage and Stun the target for 1 round. On a miss, deal half Electric damage and Stagger the target for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Thundering Strikes
upgrades.description: Passive. On any Melee attack roll of 16–20, deal an additional 1d8 Electric damage.

name: Lantern of the Lorekeeper
description: A staff topped with an ever-burning lantern. It illuminates paths that shouldn't be there.

effects.name: Brilliance
effects.description: Gain one additional Tier 1 power or upgrade from your class. This bonus is lost if you stop wielding the Lantern. You cannot upgrade it, and your choice is locked once bonded.

upgrades.name: Unending Knowledge
upgrades.description: Passive. While wielding the Lantern, your Primary Class Resource maximum increases by 1.

name: Nightmare, The Shadow's Wake
description: A two-faced hammer — one side a screaming visage, the other a serene mask. Neither face is comforting.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Two-Faced
effects.description: Stare at the rage face: gain AR up to half your Level but lose the same as DR. Stare at the calm face: gain DR up to half your Level but lose the same as AR. Look away and it functions as a mundane weapon. Your chosen stance locks until a Full Rest.

upgrades.name: Weight of the World
upgrades.description: Passive. When you roll the maximum value on any damage die, the target is Rooted for 1 round. Elites are immune.

name: Echo
description: A long rifle that fires with uncanny precision. Every shot placed, every shot counted.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Sureshot
effects.description: Re-roll any damage dice that show a 1 or 2. Use the new result.

upgrades.name: Killshot
upgrades.description: Passive. For each consecutive round you remain stationary, gain +2 damage, stacking up to your current Level. Moving resets the bonus.

name: Epilogue
description: A pistol with a glass vial socket on the barrel. Whatever you load into it comes out worse.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Arcane Shot
effects.description: The vial socket charges with arcane energy. Expend the charge to fire an arcane-infused shot.

upgrades.name: Makeshift Grenade
upgrades.description: Passive. The vial can be opened as a grenade, dealing 4d4 Arcane damage to the target and all adjacent creatures. Epilogue loses Arcane Shot until a new vial is placed.

name: The Black Maiden
description: A longsword with a blade the color of a starless sky. It finds gaps in armor as if designed for nothing else.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Straight to the Heart
effects.description: On an attack roll of 17–20, completely ignore the target's AV for that attack.

effects.name: Magnetic
effects.description: +1 Presence while equipped.

upgrades.name: No Mercy
upgrades.description: Passive. Straight to the Heart now triggers on an attack roll of 14–20 instead of 17–20.

name: Bracers of the Vanguard
description: Heavy steel bracers etched with deflection runes. They have caught more arrows than most shields.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 DR.

effects.name: Return Fire
effects.description: On a Defense roll of 18–20, deflect any reasonably-sized ranged physical projectile back at the attacker.

upgrades.name: Mirrored Steel
upgrades.description: Return Fire now also deflects magical ranged projectiles.

name: Altarion's Ward
description: A tower shield engraved with the crest of a forgotten dueling order. It rewards those who commit to the fight.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 AV.

effects.name: Duelist
effects.description: When you and your target are the only two ADJACENT units in the engagement, gain your HL as a bonus to both AR and damage.

name: Shadowmantle
description: Dark armor that seems to drink in light. Moving in it is barely a whisper.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 AV.

effects.name: Elusive
effects.description: +2 DR against Provoked Attacks.

effects.name: Shadowdancer
effects.description: While both Shadowmantle and Twilight Walkers are equipped, deal an additional 1d6 Physical damage on a successful Melee attack against a target ADJACENT to one of your Allies.

name: Twilight Walkers
description: Soft-soled boots that leave no sound and almost no footprint. Perfect for those who prefer not to be found.

effects.name: Soft as a Feather
effects.description: Add your HL to any roll involving sneaking or staying undetected.

effects.name: Shadowdancer
effects.description: While both Shadowmantle and Twilight Walkers are equipped, deal an additional 1d6 Physical damage on a successful Melee attack against a target ADJACENT to one of your Allies.

name: Solarius, Hand of the Dawn
description: A greatsword that blazes with golden light. The faithful say it remembers every divine blow ever struck.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Echoes of Light
effects.description: On an attack roll of 19–20, replicate all Divine damage dealt that round to the same target.

upgrades.name: Illumination
upgrades.description: Echoes of Light now triggers on an attack roll of 17–20 instead of 19–20.

upgrades.name: A Righteous Blade
upgrades.description: Passive. While wielding Solarius, the Judge power 'And You Shall Know His Name' doubles its bonus from +HL to +Level.

name: Dragon's Kiss
description: A dagger forged in dragonfire. It keeps you warm even when nothing else does.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Fiery Soul
effects.description: When you deal Fire damage through a power, add additional Fire damage equal to your HL.

effects.name: Unending Warmth
effects.description: +7 Frost Resistance.

upgrades.name: Dragon's Breath
upgrades.description: Passive. Gain the Mystic power Breath of Fire. Activate it by expending Primary Resource. If you already possess Breath of Fire, its Mana cost is reduced to 1.

name: Soul Razor
description: A bladed fist weapon that grows sharper with each life it takes. It wants more.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Thirst for Blood
effects.description: When you land a killing blow, heal 1 HP.

effects.name: Eternal Hunger
effects.description: After 10 kills with the Soul Razor, the healing from Thirst for Blood permanently increases by 1. This can stack up to a maximum bonus of +4.

name: Anklets of Wicked Speed
description: Lightweight anklets that buzz with restless energy. You'll feel it even when you're standing still.

effects.name: Can't Catch Me
effects.description: +2 DR against Provoked Attacks.

effects.name: Restless
effects.description: Narrative effect: your legs bounce and fidget whenever you are stationary for more than 5 minutes. Stops only when lying down.

upgrades.name: Always First
upgrades.description: Once per Full Rest, grant yourself First Strike at the start of an encounter. Doing so deals True damage equal to your Level.

name: Morning
description: One of a matched pair of blades. Lighter than it looks, and faster than you expect.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Morning's Grace
effects.description: +3 Speed when in natural or forested settings.

effects.name: Forest Blades
effects.description: While both Morning and Evening are equipped (outdoors only): Overdrive/Movement — instantly move FAR without triggering Provoked Attacks.

upgrades.name: Together as One
upgrades.description: Set Bonus. Morning and Evening intertwine into a double-bladed glaive, upgrading the damage die to 1d10.

name: Evening
description: One of a matched pair of blades. It settles into the hand like it was always meant to be there.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Evening's Cover
effects.description: +2 to stealth-related checks when in natural or forested settings.

effects.name: Forest Blades
effects.description: While both Morning and Evening are equipped (outdoors only): Overdrive/Movement — instantly move FAR without triggering Provoked Attacks.

upgrades.name: Together as One
upgrades.description: Set Bonus. Morning and Evening intertwine into a double-bladed glaive, upgrading the damage die to 1d10.

name: Dreambinder, Tome of the Deceiver
description: A book that writes contracts in your blood. You never remember signing, but the terms are always clear.

effects.name: Shrewd Bargain
effects.description: Choose 1 Main Attribute and increase it by 1, losing 5 Max HP as the cost. Tear the page to cancel the contract. Only 1 contract may be active at a time. The tome has 10 uses total.

upgrades.name: More Deals
upgrades.description: Unlock a secondary contract slot. The second contract must target AR, DR, MR, Speed, or AV (+1 for 5 Max HP). Adds 5 additional uses to the tome.
